_comment: Column layouts this pipeline has learned. Built-in schemas (raw AT&T, Alloy RG, F37) live in clean_addresses.py and always win. Entries here are checked next, most-specific first, then the generic fallback. resolve_schema.py appends here when it meets a layout nothing recognizes, so each new format costs one API call ever and is deterministic afterward. Safe to hand-edit; safe to delete an entry to force relearning.
